title: Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading “Like a Risk Asset” as Fed Hikes Loom
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading “Like a Risk Asset” as Fed Hikes Loom Tracy Shuchart says Bitcoin's biggest long-term argument is its monetary scarcity, but investors need to separate the long-term thesis from how it's trading today. This post Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading “Like a Risk Asset” as Fed Hikes Loom first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
